name: claude
description: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, started with --dangerously-skip-permissions.

settings.label: Reasoning effort
settings.description: Lower saves cost, higher suits harder autonomous work.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Model Claude Code starts on, an alias or a full id; the chat's picker can still change it. Default: Claude Code's own default.

settings.label: Mount ~/.claude
settings.description: Hands the agent a per-run copy of your Claude config directory, login included, so no token is needed. Off: the agent starts on a fresh config with the OAuth token picked below.

settings.label: Claude config directory
settings.description: Host directory copied as the agent's ~/.claude, for each run, while it is mounted.

settings.label: OAuth token
settings.description: The claude-token (from `claude setup-token`) Claude Code runs with; not needed while Mount ~/.claude hands it a logged-in one.
